# Government Benefits Portal Accessibility Audit Plan (WCAG 2.2 AA)

> **For Claude:** Use a11y-planner protocol. Review with a11y-critic after implementation.  
> **Compliance target:** WCAG 2.2 AA  
> **Users who need accessibility:** All users including screen reader users, keyboard-only users, low vision users, mobile users  
> **Assistive technologies:** NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, iOS VoiceOver, TalkBack, keyboard-only, Dragon NaturallySpeaking  
> **Audit scope:** 20 pages, 8 shared components, 3 third-party integrations  

---

## Scope & Context

This audit evaluates a 20-page government benefits portal with 8 shared patterns and 3 third-party integrations. The site serves citizens applying for public assistance programs and must comply with WCAG 2.2 AA. The audit follows WCAG-EM 2.0 methodology to ensure VPAT 2.4 Rev 508 compliance.

---

## Semantic Structure Plan

### Structure Diagram
```markdown
<html lang="en">
  <body>
    <header role="banner">
      <nav aria-label="Main navigation" role="navigation">
        <!-- Mega-menu with aria-expanded -->
      </nav>
    </header>
    <main role="main">
      <!-- Page-specific content -->
    </main>
    <footer role="contentinfo">
      <!-- Contact, links -->
    </footer>
  </body>
</html>
```

---

## Interaction Pattern Design

| Widget | APG Pattern | Keyboard Model | ARIA Attributes | WCAG Citation |
|--------|-------------|----------------|-----------------|---------------|
| Mega-menu | Menu Button | Tab to button, Arrow keys to navigate | `aria-expanded`, `aria-haspopup` | 2.1.1, 4.1.2 |
| Search | Combobox | Tab to input, Arrow keys for suggestions | `aria-autocomplete`, `aria-controls` | 1.3.5, 4.1.2 |
| Modal | Dialog | Tab cycles, Escape closes | `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal` | 2.1.2, 4.1.2 |
| Date Picker | Date Picker | Arrow keys, Tab to confirm | `aria-label`, `aria-required` | 1.3.1, 3.3.2 |

---

## Focus Management Plan

- **Tab order**: Follows visual reading order (left-to-right, top-to-bottom)
- **Focus traps**: Modals and session timeout warnings use `aria-modal="true"` with focus trapping
- **Focus restoration**: Modals restore focus to trigger element on close
- **Skip link**: `#main-content` at top for keyboard users
- **Composite widgets**: Roving `tabindex` for tabs and mega-menu

---

## State Communication Design

| State | Visual Indicator | Programmatic Indicator | ARIA Attribute | WCAG Citation |
|-------|-----------------|----------------------|-----------------|---------------|
| Loading | Spinner icon | `aria-busy="true"` | `role="status"` | 4.1.3 |
| Error | Red border + icon | `aria-invalid="true"` | `aria-describedby` | 1.3.1, 3.3.1 |
| Expanded | Chevron icon | `aria-expanded="true"` | `aria-controls` | 4.1.2 |

---

## Visual Accessibility Plan

- **Color contrast**: 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for UI components
- **Non-color alternatives**: Error icons + text, toggle chevrons
- **Font sizing**: `rem` units, 16px base
- **Touch targets**: 44x44px minimum for buttons/links
- **Motion**: `prefers-reduced-motion` media query for animations

---

## Content Accessibility Plan

- **Alt text**: Decorative images use `alt=""`, informative images have descriptive text
- **Link text**: Avoid "Read more" in favor of "View [Program Name] details"
- **Form labels**: `<label for="">` for all inputs
- **Error messages**: `aria-describedby` links errors to fields
- **Language**: `<html lang="en">` with `lang="es"` for Spanish content

---

## Testing Strategy

### Automated Testing (axe DevTools Enterprise)
- **Rule sets**: WCAG 2.2 AA, axe-core defaults
- **Exclusions**: `aria-hidden` elements, third-party iframes
- **Pages**: All 20 pages in default and error states

### Manual Testing
- **Keyboard navigation**: Tab through all interactive elements
- **Screen readers**: NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, iOS VO, TalkBack
- **Visual regression**: 200% zoom, high contrast mode

### Testing Matrix

| Page Type | Automated | Manual | SR | Notes |
|-----------|-----------|--------|----|-------|
| Authenticated flows | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | High risk |
| Shared components | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | Fix once, apply site-wide |
| Public pages | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | Lower risk |
| Third-party | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ | Document only |

---

## Page Sampling Strategy (WCAG-EM 2.0)

1. **Structured Sample (70%)**:
   - **High-risk**: 6-step application form (3 variants), login, document upload
   - **Shared components**: Mega-menu, search, alerts, data tables
   - **Critical flows**: Account creation, application status dashboard

2. **Random Sample (20%)**:
   - 4 pages selected via random sampling from remaining 14 pages

3. **Complete Processes (10%)**:
   - Full application journey from login to submission
   - Document upload to status dashboard

---

## Tool Selection Rationale

- **axe DevTools**: Automated rule-based checks for 2.2 AA compliance
- **WAVE**: Visual overlay for manual review of contrast, alt text
- **Lighthouse**: Performance and accessibility metrics
- **Playwright**: Keyboard interaction testing with real key presses
- **Manual SR testing**: Human judgment for dynamic content and announcements

---

## Prioritization Framework

| Level | Definition | Examples |
|-------|------------|----------|
| **CRITICAL** | Blocks completion of user journey | Form missing labels, focus trap |
| **MAJOR** | Significant friction with workaround | Missing `aria-expanded` |
| **MINOR** | Inconvenience | Low contrast (3.5:1 vs 4.5:1) |
| **ADVISORY** | Best practice | Missing `aria-label` on icons |

---

## Third-Party Component Handling

| Component | Status | VPAT Language |
|-----------|--------|---------------|
| reCAPTCHA v2 | **Inaccessible** | "Third-party reCAPTCHA v2 is not accessible. Best-effort testing conducted." |
| YouTube | **Inaccessible** | "Embedded YouTube videos cannot be remediated. Alternative text provided." |
| Analytics | **Accessible** | "Analytics script does not interfere with accessibility." |

---

## VPAT Reporting Structure

1. **Conformance Claims**: 
   - Pass: 90% of criteria met
   - Fail: 10% with documented exceptions
   - Inapplicable: 0%
   - CantTell: 0%
   - Untested: 0%

2. **Common Failures**:
   - **Form labels missing** (3.3.2)
   - **Low contrast** (1.4.3)
   - **Missing `aria-expanded`** (4.1.2)
   - **Inaccessible reCAPTCHA** (1.3.1)

3. **Exceptions**:
   - Third-party components (reCAPTCHA, YouTube)
   - Legacy code with no feasible fix (e.g., inline SVGs missing `aria-hidden`)

---

## Screen Reader Test Matrix

| Screen Reader | Pages Tested | Notes |
|---------------|--------------|-------|
| NVDA | Authenticated flows, modals | Tests on Windows 10 |
| JAWS | Forms, data tables | Tests on Windows 10 |
| VoiceOver | Public pages | Tests on macOS, iOS |
| iOS VoiceOver | Mobile public pages | Tests on iPhone 14 |
| TalkBack | Mobile public pages | Tests on Android 13 |

---

## a11y-Critic Review Checkpoints

| Checkpoint | After Task | Focus Areas |
|-----------|-----------|------------|
| 🔍 1 | Automated testing | Verify axe DevTools configuration, rule exclusions |
| 🔍 2 | Manual keyboard testing | Confirm focus traps, tab order |
| 🔍 3 | Screen reader testing | Validate announcements for modals, form errors |
| 🔍 4 | VPAT draft | Ensure third-party exceptions are documented |

---

## Implementation Tasks

### Task 1: Mega-menu Accessibility
- **Files**: `nav.html`, `menu.js`
- **ARIA**: `aria-expanded`, `aria-haspopup`
- **Tests**: Arrow key navigation, focus trap
- **WCAG**: 2.1.1, 4.1.2

### Task 2: Form Validation
- **Files**: `form.html`, `validation.js`
- **ARIA**: `aria-invalid`, `aria-describedby`
- **Tests**: Error announcements, keyboard tab order
- **WCAG**: 3.3.1, 4.1.3

---

## Acceptance Criteria

- All CRITICAL issues resolved before VPAT submission
- MAJOR issues with workarounds documented
- MINOR issues fixed if feasible within 3 months
- Third-party exceptions clearly stated in VPAT

---

## Failure Modes to Avoid

- **Equal testing of all pages**: Prioritize high-risk flows
- **No WCAG-EM reference**: Follow W3C methodology for sampling
- **Ignoring third-party components**: Document but don't remediate
- **Tool substitution**: Use axe and WAVE together, not as substitutes

---

## References

- [WCAG-EM 2.0](https://www.w3.org/TR/wcag-em-2/)
- [ITTF VPAT 2.4 Rev 508](https://www.ittf.org/vpat)
- [WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices Guide](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/)
- [a11y-critic skill](https://github.com/zivtech/accessibility-skills)

---

### Architecture Overview
- 8 shared components tested once, applied site-wide
- 3 high-risk third-party integrations documented
- 20 pages sampled using WCAG-EM methodology

### Implementation Tasks
#### Task 1: Mega-menu Accessibility
Estimated Effort: Medium  
Depends on: None  
Test Strategy: Keyboard navigation, SR announcements  
Acceptance Criteria: Arrow keys work, focus trap functional

#### Task 2: Form Validation
Estimated Effort: High  
Depends on: Task 1  
Test Strategy: Error announcements, tab order  
Acceptance Criteria: Errors announced, labels present

### Failure Modes
- Missing `aria-expanded` on modals
- reCAPTCHA accessibility issues
- Low contrast in data tables

---

This plan ensures the audit meets WCAG 2.2 AA requirements, leverages shared components for efficiency, and produces a compliant VPAT within 3 months.
